summary.en:
- [[character:aglaea]] is a strong Blast DPS who converts SPD to ATK and has huge SPD self-buffs, allowing her to take an extremely high number of turns.
- Ultimate activates "Supreme Stance". Here, she deals damaged through her Enhanced Basic ATK; this is a Joint ATK with her Memosprite, Garmentmaker. Her and Garmentmaker have a relatively even total damage share.
- Damage outside of "Supreme Stance" is pitiful, and she has a whopping 350 Energy cost. As such, she is one of the most Energy-reliant DPS, but generally cannot ensure 100% "Supreme Stance" uptime without at least two of the following: her E1, [[character:sunday]], and [[character:cyrene]].
- High turn frequency means that ally buffs expire quickly on her. Her damage per action is also somewhat low.

details.en:
- E1 grants her additional Energy every time she or Garmentmaker attacks her "Seam Stitch" target, greatly improving Ultimate uptime, resulting in a massive upgrade. Also inflicts 15% Vulnerability on this enemy.
- Even in teams where she has 100% Ultimate uptime, her E1 can grant her more turns.
- E2 grants her and Garmentmaker 14% DEF Ignore for each consecutive action they take, up to 3 stacks. This is strongest when paired with DEF Ignore from [[character:cyrene]].
